theme: Notch signaling via regulated intramembrane proteolysis
story: The centre is Notch signaling: activation of NOTCH1-4 receptors, release of their intracellular domains and their regulation of transcription through Notch-HLH targets, plus negative regulators and the constitutively active NOTCH1 and FBXW7-loss mutants found in cancer. Around it sit other receptors cleaved by the same gamma-secretase type of intramembrane proteolysis: p75NTR (with NRIF death and NF-kB survival signals), ERBB4 nuclear signaling and amyloid fiber formation from APP processing. Notch-dependent fate decisions such as pancreatic bud branching and Th2 differentiation, and the neighbouring Wnt pathway, fill out the cluster, which as a whole describes cleavage of a membrane receptor to release a domain that travels to the nucleus and sets cell fate.

theme: Dendritic cell maturation and T cell costimulation
story: The core is the antigen-presenting dendritic cell: dendritic cell signatures, regulation of DC differentiation in both directions, and myeloid DC activation. The T cell side completes the picture: TCR contact with peptide-MHC on the APC, costimulation, CD4 alpha-beta T cell proliferation, T cell surface activation markers and restraint of T cell migration. Together the cluster describes the immune synapse through which DCs prime and regulate T cell responses.

theme: B cell development, differentiation and proliferation
story: The centre is B cell identity and maturation: B cell transcriptional modules covering naive, memory and differentiating B cells, along with B cell development and activation. Positive regulation of B cell differentiation and proliferation, B-1 cell differentiation and proliferation during immune responses supply the growth and fate-control side, and the generic lymphocyte and T & B development modules give the wider lymphoid context. The cluster as a whole describes how B cells develop and expand to take part in humoral immunity.

theme: RIG-I/MDA5 cytosolic RNA sensing and antiviral interferon
story: The core is RIG-I-like receptor signaling: RIG-I/DDX58 and MDA5/IFIH1 sense cytosolic and exogenous dsRNA, under positive and negative regulation. Downstream adaptors relay the signal through TRAF3 to IRF activation, TRAF6 to IRF7 and NF-kB, and FADD/RIP1-caspase-8/10 to NF-kB, which drives type I interferon signaling. RSV evasion of interferon shows how viruses attack this route, and the cluster as a whole is the cell-intrinsic antiviral innate response to RNA viruses.

theme: DNA double-strand break repair pathway choice and defects
story: The cluster covers the full response to DNA double-strand breaks: sensing and ATM-mediated recruitment, end processing and resection, and then the competing repair routes of homologous recombination (presynaptic strand exchange, D-loop resolution by SDSA or Holliday junctions), classical NHEJ, alt-NHEJ/MMEJ and single-strand annealing. Positive and negative regulators of HR and NHEJ set the pathway choice. Many members are disease-defect pathways in BRCA1, BARD1, BRCA2 and PALB2 that impair homologous recombination, linking this repair machinery to hereditary cancer susceptibility and genome stability.

theme: NK cell and cytotoxic lymphocyte killing
story: The centre is the natural killer cell: NK transcriptional and surface signatures, receptor-driven activation, and positive regulation of NK cytotoxicity, degranulation, cytokine production and tumour killing. Immunoregulatory receptor interactions between lymphoid and non-lymphoid cells give target recognition, T cell-mediated cytotoxicity adds the CD8 arm, and granzyme-mediated cell death is the shared effector mechanism. Together the cluster describes cellular defence through cytotoxic lymphocytes killing infected or transformed cells.

theme: T cell receptor activation and T cell differentiation
story: The core is T cell activation: TCR signaling with costimulation, the T cell activation modules and the ITK/PKC route to differentiation. The IL2/IL7/TCR network adds the cytokine signals that sustain T cell survival and expansion, and the regulation of CD8 alpha-beta and gamma-delta T cell differentiation gives the lineage outcomes. The cluster describes how antigen and cytokine signals activate T cells and drive them toward effector fates.

theme: NMDA receptor calcium signaling in synaptic plasticity
story: The centre is glutamate-gated NMDA receptor signaling: receptor assembly and surface delivery, Mg2+ unblocking and activation, negative regulation, and the AMPA receptors that depolarize the synapse alongside them. Calcium entry through NMDARs drives downstream cascades (Ras, RAC1, AMPK via CAMKK, and CaMKII/CaMKIV phosphorylation of CREB) that link synaptic activity to gene expression. Together with cellular responses to glutamate and electrical stimulation, the cluster describes the molecular basis of long-term potentiation and activity-dependent plasticity.

theme: Germinal centre B cell maturation to memory and plasma cells
story: The core is B cell biology across many B cell transcriptional modules, covering BCR signaling, B cell differentiation and proliferation, and naive and memory B cell signatures. The germinal centre reaction ties it together: T follicular helper differentiation and ICOS and CD27 costimulation provide T cell help, germinal centre B cell differentiation follows, and plasma cell differentiation and immunoglobulin modules give the antibody-secreting output, with memory B cells and adaptive immune memory as the lasting product. The cluster as a whole describes the humoral response from B cell activation to immunoglobulin production and memory.

The centre is membrane traffic through the Golgi: vesicle biogenesis at the TGN, Golgi retention and localization, retrograde Golgi-to-ER transport, and constitutive secretion. Endosomal routes branch from it: endocytosis, endosome fusion and organization, receptor recycling, and early- and late-endosome-to-Golgi retrograde transport, along with Golgi-to-lysosome delivery and lysosome vesicle biogenesis. Rab GTPase regulation (TBC/RabGAPs) and vesicle docking supply the targeting machinery, so the cluster as a whole describes how the cell sorts cargo between secretion, recycling and lysosomes.
